description: Implementation of TCP Cubic congestion control algorithm with byte-based window management for QUIC protocol.

classes.name: TcpCubicSenderBytes
classes.description: Implements TCP Cubic congestion control with byte-based window management for QUIC.

methods.name: SetFromConfig
methods.description: Configures congestion control parameters based on received connection options.

methods.name: AdjustNetworkParameters
methods.description: Adjusts congestion window based on network bandwidth and RTT.

methods.name: RenoBeta
methods.description: Calculates Reno backoff factor after packet loss.

methods.name: OnCongestionEvent
methods.description: Handles congestion events, including ACKs and losses.

methods.name: OnPacketAcked
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of packets, potentially increasing congestion window.

methods.name: CanSend
methods.description: Determines if the sender can send more data based on congestion window.

methods.name: PacingRate
methods.description: Calculates pacing rate based on current congestion window and RTT.

methods.name: BandwidthEstimate
methods.description: Estimates current bandwidth based on congestion window and RTT.

methods.name: InSlowStart
methods.description: Checks if in slow start phase.

methods.name: IsCwndLimited
methods.description: Checks if congestion window limits sending.

methods.name: InRecovery
methods.description: Checks if in recovery state after packet loss.

methods.name: GetCongestionControlType
methods.description: Returns the type of congestion control in use.
